## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Verification

List the checks run and any unverified behavior. Include recovery, ownership and
real-Redis tests when changing storage or coordination.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] Public API and compatibility changes are documented.
- [ ] A `CHANGES/` fragment is included where appropriate.
- [ ] No credentials, generated audit reports or local environment files are included.
